did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A seller who sells in several sections (Rahim Traders: wood, clothing, electronics, home, beauty, books, pantry, jewellery) opened How you are doing and used the switcher at the top: All together, then Wood, then Electronics.

checks.text: The switcher lists every section the seller sells in, with All together first
All together shows the best sellers across everything (Shea body butter 19, Leather-bound notebook 16, Sundarbans honey 16)
Wood shows only wood products as best sellers (Sheesham bookshelf 13, Handmade walnut tray 9, Carved bedside table 3), with their own sales and what is left
Electronics shows only electronics (Desk speaker 11, Wireless earbuds 9, Slim power bank 9); the two businesses never mix
The rank (99, Excellent) is the same in each view: it is one score for the person, because buyers meet the person, not the section

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. This is one login with a switcher, which is what the chapter's note allows, not two separate logins.
